registration_stage: after protocol freeze and synthetic-only tests; before any FEVEROUS development row, baseline prediction row, or Wikipedia database content was downloaded or inspected
frozen_implementation_claims: candidate pages are derived only from official baseline predicted_evidence
candidate units are deterministically extracted and BM25-pruned without gold
the v43 target cardinality is exactly the count of distinct dynamic-role argmax candidate ids, clamped to one through five
the v41 role-coverage objective, models, score calibration, budgets, and tie-breaking remain unchanged
gold annotations are joined only after complete ordered query and score caches pass validation
post_registration_change_policy: Any semantic code or test change invalidates this registration and requires a new protocol version before FEVEROUS content access.
